title: Integrate and prove the first clean-generation candidate
purpose: After independent acceptance of runtime, authoring and contradictory-QA outputs, create the deterministic build, exact source manifest, unified check runner, release envelope and permanent CI workflow. The integrator combines reviewed outputs without silently editing role-owned files.
invariants: Integration starts only after reviewed result commits exist for DEV-WP-031, KIT-WP-001 and QA-WP-011.
The integrator owns only the five exact integration paths.
A defect in a role-owned file is returned to that role and is not silently repaired by the integrator.
The source manifest lists every committed successor source, authoring, fixture and test file exactly once and records hashes deterministically.
The build uses Python standard library only and emits no timestamp, random value or environment path.
Two clean builds produce byte-identical learnit-next.html artifacts.
The artifact tested is the artifact placed in the release envelope.
CI runs contract, storage-isolation, browser vertical-slice and build-determinism gates.
No generated dist or release file is committed.
No RC718 file, storage behavior or artifact changes.
requiredEvidence: Exact reviewed input commits and integration order are recorded.
The source manifest and changed-path inventory prove the 32-file budget exactly.
Clean build succeeds twice with one SHA-256.
Contract and semantic checks pass for fixtures and both golden kits.
Browser storage-isolation and vertical-slice suites pass on the exact artifact.
The release envelope records source commit, manifest digest, artifact digest and test results.
Permanent CI and PR scope pass on the exact integrated result.
A separate governor acceptance PR is created before human testing.
adversarialTests: Fail when the 32-file set differs by one path.
Fail when source manifest content is stale or uncommitted.
Fail when two clean builds differ.
Fail when a test runs against an artifact with a different digest from the release candidate.
Fail when RC718 protected storage changes after successor boot, import, session or reset.
Fail when legacy import causes any transient or durable installation.
Fail when the integrator diff includes a role-owned file.
Fail when any held platform domain or unplanned dependency is introduced.
nonGoals: Repairing runtime, authoring or QA files within the integrator scope.
Changing the frozen schema or architecture design.
Expanding the activity families or file budget.
Publishing a release or promoting a human candidate directly.
Entering any backend, account, sync, catalog, commerce, tenancy or marketplace domain.
independentReview: Integrator verifies exact input provenance and role-scope compliance.
Contradictory QA reruns all gates on the exact integrated artifact.
Governor reviews source-to-artifact identity, residual risks and human-gate readiness.
Human testing occurs only after a separate governor GO_WITH_CONDITIONS or GO.
rollback: Revert the five integration files and discard the unpromoted successor artifact. Reviewed role outputs remain available for correction or reintegration; RC718 remains the active legacy product.
